observations: Three photos show a black LG monitor on a wooden desk, with a small black device (possibly a mini PC or docking station) placed in front of it.
The monitor is turned off; the screen is dark and reflects some light.
The LG logo is visible on the bottom bezel in all three photos.
In photo 1 and photo 2, text is visible on the bottom bezel next to the LG logo: 'MODEL: 20M38A 1920 x 1080 60Hz'.
The monitor has a thick bezel and a stand with a circular base.
The background shows shelves with boxed electronics, suggesting a retail or second-hand store environment.
The monitor appears to be in used condition with some smudges and reflections on the screen.

claims.evidence: LG logo visible on bottom bezel in all photos.
Model number '20M38A' visible in photo 1 and photo 2, which corresponds to a 20-inch monitor.
Monitor is shown turned off in all photos; no video or power-on state is visible. No proof of functionality.

risks.risk: Monitor may not be working or may have dead pixels, screen burn-in, or other display defects.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the monitor powered on, displaying a test pattern or video, with close-up of screen for defects.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged cables (HDMI, VGA, power) or stand.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories, including cables and stand, laid out clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming accessories are missing or damaged, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Video showing the monitor powered on and displaying content.
Photo of all included cables and accessories.
Close-up of the screen for dead pixels or defects.
response.reason: The monitor's model and brand are confirmed, but its working condition is unverified. Without proof of functionality, it cannot be priced accurately. The risks of non-functionality or missing accessories must be resolved before pricing.
